name: Lulu
source:
A high-tech Embryo that makes use of the latest generation of Ether Drive. She shows Belios absolute loyalty, and becomes a killing machine that exists only to carry out his orders. She often displays a sense of rivalry towards Lala, the Embryo who fights for Energeia.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
